content: Nil jesus.angan Wik Kath Waaꞌ Pam Alantaman Minh Sheepan Piꞌ-Piꞌ

Nil Jesus.angan wik kath waaꞌ thant. Nil yimanangan thaw thant, “Kan inan ngeeyāna! Ngay wik kath inan waaꞌang niiyant. Nil pam shepherdanganiy-a, minh sheep nungantaman piꞌ-piꞌan thanang. Nil ngutangan-a, aak paddockangan ngoonchathan thanang, paanthathan thanang. Nil pam thonamangan-a, thaaꞌ gate.an piꞌ-piꞌana aak paddockana. Nil pam shepherdana aak paddockangan ngoonchan-a, niliy-a, thaaꞌ gate wakanangan ngoonchan, nil puth pamangan thaaꞌ gate.an piꞌ-piꞌana, erkam paththam thapathan nungant, pam mooman yipam ngoonchow. Minh sheep nungantam al-alangan-a, man awal thiichantan nunang, moom thanttaman. Nilan namp-nampaman wichan thanang, aꞌ yoon pentathan thanang, minh anangan. Nil kanan pentathan thanang yoonan-a, niliy-a, umputh iiy-iiyan thanttang, minh al-alangana koy-koyyuw monkan-wakantan nunang, puth than man awal nunangan kan thiichantan. Pam waywey wampiy-a, aak paddock aakanakana, nil thaaꞌ gate.aman-a, keꞌ ngoonchiy. Niliy-a, fence wakanang matiy, anpalan ngoonchiy, minh sheep anangan yipam maꞌ-kuchathow. Puth than minh sheep al-alangan-a, keꞌ monkan-wakiythan nunang, yaꞌa, than winynyang moꞌiythan nungantam, than puth man awal keꞌ thiichiythan nunang, pam thon anan nil moom thanttam yaꞌa.”
Jesus.angan wik kath inan waaꞌ thant, puth than pam wanchangan keꞌam min-min ngaantam-ngeeyin wik kath inangan want-wanttakan waaꞌ-waaꞌ thant.
Nil Jesus.angan Waaꞌ Nungamang Nil Moom Min Ngamparaman
Nil puth Jesus.an-a, putham thaw thant, “Ngay inan kan-kanam thawang niiyant: ngay keꞌ thaaꞌ gate yimanangan pam wanch ngatharam anangan yipam ngoonchayn aak piip ngatharamakan.

Keenkanaman-a, than pam piꞌ-piꞌanam wiy anangan wampin, than keꞌ pam maꞌ-kuchan yimanangan wampin. Than puth pam wanchant waaꞌ-waaꞌin thanttakam nil keꞌ God.angan kuch thanang, puth yaꞌa, yaan wik uuy-uuyamin. Pam wanch God.antam al-alangan-a, than wik keꞌam ngeeyin thanang pam wayanang anangan, yaꞌa, keꞌ minh sheep al-alangana pam thonana moom thanttam yaꞌana, than man awal keꞌam thiichin nunang, yaꞌa.

Ngay keꞌ thaaꞌ gate yimanangan. Than weeꞌ-weeꞌanangan thaaꞌ gate ngatharam wakanang anpalan ngoonchayn aak piip God.antamakan-a, yaa, ngayan ngul kaaꞌ-piichanathāng thanang way thanttam anpalan, aꞌ minam piꞌ-piꞌāng thanang. Than ngangk min ngul iiy-iiyayn, keꞌ minh sheep anangan ngangk minan iiy-iiyantan moom thanttam al-alantangan, wak thak yot uw-uwantan mungkanakan.

Puth nil pam wayan wampowa, yipam minh sheep anangan maꞌ-kuchathow, aꞌ mul-mulathow thanang. Puth ngayaniya keꞌ pam way anan yaꞌa, ngay aak iikanakan wampangana than pam wanchangan yipam piip God.an ngangk minangam paththam monkan-wak-wakayn nunang.

“Ngayiya moom min paththaman niiyantama, ngay keꞌ pam moom min anan nil minh sheep anangan min-minakaman piꞌ-piꞌan thanang. Nil yimanangan ngaantam-ngeeyan nungantakam, ‘Kuꞌ kulliy al-alangan mak mulathayn ngayang, than minh sheep ngatharam anangan yipmam man-yetham iiy-iiyayn.’

Puth nil pam thon alangan nathwey minh sheep anangan yaanan nath piꞌ-piꞌiy thanangan-a, nil moom yaꞌana, nil yaan thonakaman workan iiy-iiy pam alantana. Nil kuꞌ kulliy nathan wampiy-a, minh sheep anangan yipam mulathowan-a, an nil minh sheep anangan thaaꞌ nung-nung too wantiy thanang, nil kamp moꞌiy thanttamana. Nil kuꞌ kulliyangan-a, minh sheep wiy anangan pathiy thanang, aꞌ nath ngul wichiy thanang, aꞌ wiy anangan nath-nath ngul yaarkamiythan.

Nil puth paman winynyang moꞌan, aꞌ too wantan thanang minh sheep anangan. Nil puth moom thanttam yaꞌa, nil minh sheep anangan meekantam yaan piꞌ-piꞌ thanang, keꞌ-paal nil min-miniyakam keꞌam piꞌ-piꞌ thanang.

“Ngay keꞌ pam anan yimanangan yaꞌa. Ngay keꞌ moom thanttam min-minam paththam sheepantamana. Pam wanch ngatharam anangan-a, keꞌ minh sheep ngatharam yimanangan iiy-iiyantan. Ngay meeꞌmiy thanang, aꞌ than ngayangan-a, meeꞌmiy thampa, keꞌ piip ngatharamangan yimanangan meeꞌmiy ngayang, ngay puth yimanang thamp meeꞌmiy nunang piip ngatharaman. Aꞌ putha, ngay ngul theetathāng ngatharakama, uthamāng niiyant, pam wanch ngatharamakana.

Pam wanch puungk wiy anangan-a, an keꞌ sheep ngatharam thamp, puth than ngatharangan yippak keꞌam iiy-iiyantan yaꞌa. Ngay puth thanang thamp mak wampathāng, than wik ngatharaman ngul ngeeyayn. Anpalaniy-a, than yotam karpam ngul iiy-iiyayn ngatharangan, keꞌ minh sheep anangan moom thonamantangan iiy-iiyantan.
“Puth piip ngatharaman-a, kaangk wunan ngathar, puth anpalan ngayan kaangk theetathāng ngathamang, yipam mulan wunāng niiyantak. Puth anpalaniya, ngay koyaman ngul man-yetham weemāng.

Pam wanch wiyangan keꞌam thaach-thaachin ngayang pal aak iikanakan wampāng, yipam uthamāngan niiyant, yaꞌa! Ngay iniya ngay-ngayam kaangk wunanga ngathamangan theetathāng yipam uthamāng niiyantak. Kaangk ngaywey theetathāng ngathamang-a, yaa, an ngath-ngath. Kaangk ngaywey koyaman man-yetham iiy-iiyāng-a, yaa, an yimananga ngath-ngatha. Puth inaniy-a, wik piip ngatharamantaman nilan thaw ngathar yimanangan iiyāng.”
Than wik nungantaman ngeeyin-a, than Jews anangan putham ngul wik thaw-thawin thanttakaman. Puungk wiy al-alangan-a, min waaꞌ-waaꞌin nunang puth than wiy al-alanganiy-a, ep way waaꞌ-waaꞌin nunang.
Than pam wanch yot anangan thaw-thawin, “Nil oony ngangkangan piꞌ-piꞌan a! Nanpalan nil kuchek way wun-wunana! Niiy ngul ngeenak wik nungantaman ngeeyān a?”

Puth than pam wanch puungk wiy anangan thaw-thawin, “Pamang oonywey ngangkangan piꞌ-piꞌiywey-a, wik min yimanangan keꞌ thaw-thawiy, yaꞌa! Puth nil oony wayangan meeꞌ min keꞌ yumpiya! pam meeꞌ koꞌanchaniya! Yaꞌ ey!”
Than Jesus.antan Man-Mangkam Theeꞌin
Anpalaniy-a, aak kan wamp may piꞌanan mungkayn, aak Jerusalem angan, Dedication.an waaꞌantan. Aakaniy-a, onchan min, aakan kuchar ngul wun.

Nil Jesus.aniy-a, aawuch ngench thayanakan iiy, aꞌ aak verandah.angan iiy-iiy, nil Solomon.angan keenkanaman yump. Than Jews anangan-a, angman weentanam thanin nungant, Jesus.antan, aꞌ thawin nungant, “Ayyang, nint yaam wik wuthanang thaw-thawangan ngant ey? Nint wik engkanang waaꞌān ngant a! nint ngul in pam anan ey? nil God.angan keenkanaman kaaꞌngak kuchowan ey?”

Nil puth Jesus.an thaw thant, “Ngay puth kan waaꞌangan niiyanta, puth niiyan kaangk keꞌ ngeeyān, wik ngatharaman, niiy wanttak man-ngeeyaniy ngayang a! Puth work piꞌ-piꞌanam ngayan yump-yumpang niiyantan-a, an piip ngatharaman thaw ngath yimanangan yumpāng. Work piꞌ-piꞌanam il-ilangan-a, meen-meenathan niiyant, nil God.angan miꞌ ngayang aak iikanakan ukāng niiyant.
Puth niiyiy-a, pam wanch ngatharam yaꞌa, niiy keꞌ-paal kaangk keꞌ wik ngatharaman ngeeyān, niiy man-ngeeyaniy ngayang anman.

Pam wanch ngatharam al-alangan-a, wik ngatharaman-a, ngeeyantan, keꞌ minh sheep al-alangan man awal moom thanttaman ngeeyantan nunang, yimanangan. Puth ngayaniy-a, meeꞌmiy thanang, aꞌ than monkan-wak-wakantan ngayang.
Thananiy-a, ngangk aak umpuyangaman ngul wun-wunayn, an than keꞌ-ngul uthamiythan, yaꞌa; an puth weeꞌangam maꞌam piiyiy ngayangana pam wanch ngatharam anangan a? Yaꞌa! An than ngath ngula!

Nil piip ngatharamangan-a, nilan theeꞌ thanang ngathara, niliya wuut piꞌan paththam, nil keꞌ pam wiy yimanangan yaꞌa! an puth weeꞌangam maꞌam piiyiy piip ngatharamaniya thananga pam wanch ngatharam ananganiya? An yaꞌa! An thana maꞌ nungantang ngul wunayna!
Ngan piip ngatharamangan karpam iiy-iiyanan, keꞌ thonam anman.”
Than puth Jews al-alanganiy-a, putham ngul kunttow maayin nungant, keꞌ kunttowangan piikiythan nunang, Jesus.an.

Puth Jesus.an thaw thant, pam wanch al-alantan, “Ngay puth work piꞌan yot meeꞌ niiyantangan yump-yumpangana, nil piip ngatharaman thawar yumpānga. Work piꞌan want-wanttinpala niiy ngayangan kaangk kunttowangan piikāna?”

Puth than Jews anangan thawin nungant, “Ngan kaangk kunttowang piikān nintang, ngeenama, putha work piꞌan nintan yump-yumpangan anpalan yaꞌa, puth inpalana: nint ina keꞌ God.an waaꞌ-waaꞌangan nungkamanga aꞌ namp nungantaman way-wayathangan, God.antaman. Puth nintaniy-a, God yaꞌ paththam, nint keꞌ pam ngan inmana yimanangan iiy-iiyangan a!”
Nil Jesus.an thaw thant, “Than wik inangan keenkanaman umpin lat ngench thayanangan, wik God.antaman nilan thaw, ‘Niiyiy-a, keꞌ moom wuut piꞌan keꞌ God yimanangan.’
Ngamp meeꞌmiy wik lat ngench thayanangan-a, kan-kanam paththam ngulakam wunow. Yaa, puth God.angan moom wuut piꞌan waaꞌ thanang pam anangan nil wik nungantaman waaꞌ thant.
Puth ngayangana nilam miꞌ, aak iikanakan kuchanya. Niiy puth ngeenak waaꞌ-waaꞌaniy ngayangan keꞌ ngay namp God.antaman way-wayathing puth anpalan ngay nhengk God.antaman waaꞌang ngathamanga?

Niiy nath wik ngatharaman kaangk keꞌ ngeeyāna. Yaa, niiy puth work piꞌ-piꞌanam ngatharam anangan ngayan meen-meenathang niiyanta, niiy ngaantam-ngeeyān a! Ngay puth work piip ngatharamantam keꞌwey iiying-a, an epa niiy man-ngeeyin ngayanga. Puth ngay work nungantam anangan iiy-iiyingwey-a, yaa, niiy ngaantam-ngeeyāna, work il-ilangan puth meenathan niiyanta nil piip ngatharamana, inman ngatharangan, aꞌ ngayiy putha, piip ngatharamantang anman.”
Than putham ngul keꞌ mamiythan nunanga, puth yaꞌa, nil Jesus.aniy-a, maꞌam pent thanttam.
Aꞌ nil koyam ngul iiy wonk woꞌuwayn aak Jordan River aakanakaman, aak anana nil John.angan kootran kuungk-kuungk thanang ngakangan, aꞌ angman ngul wun.

Pam wanch yot wampin nungant, aꞌ thawin thanttakam, “Pam John alanganiy-a, nil work piꞌ-piꞌanam keꞌam yump-yumpa, yaꞌa, puth wik yot anangan nilan waaꞌ-waaꞌ Jesus.antaman-a, an kan-kanam anman waaꞌ-waaꞌ nunang.”
Anpalan-a, pam wanch yotangan-a, ngaantam-ngeeyin nunang Jesus.an ngula, aꞌ ngangkangam piꞌ-piꞌin nunang ngul.
